policy: One authoritative proof per distinct state transition or failure mode; do not multiply equivalent channel, timing, ruler, or verdict permutations.

turns: When I rise against our ruler, will you pledge that your clan will stand with me?

I am Egan of fen Niabar. Gwyin of Wyrecairn and Rhydan have already sworn to move with us. My house will secure Zeonica and the roads, and when we prevail your clan will hold Llanoc Hen Castle as a hereditary fief and keep a permanent council seat. Those are my specific terms. Give me your final answer now: will you pledge your clan to my rebellion against our ruler without further condition?
I am preparing to challenge our ruler. Tell me plainly if your clan refuses to support my rebellion.

I have named no allies, prepared no secure route, and I offer your clan neither land, title, gold, nor protection. I will not improve those terms. Give me your final answer: do you refuse to support my rebellion?
I intend to rebel against our ruler. Before you give me a final answer, tell me what concerns would govern whether your clan supports me.

I hear your concern. I have no secure route, no committed allies I can prove to you, and I offer your clan no land, title, gold, or protection. I will continue preparing the rebellion regardless. Give me your final answer now: will your clan support my planned rebellion against our ruler, or refuse me?

By this private letter, I ask you to consider whether your clan could stand with me when I rebel against our ruler. Do not give me a final answer yet; write back with the concerns that would govern your decision.

Gwyin of Wyrecairn and Rhydan have already sworn to move with us. My house will secure Zeonica and the roads, and when we prevail your clan will hold Llanoc Hen Castle as a hereditary fief and keep a permanent council seat. These are my sealed, specific terms. Write back now with your final pledge to my rebellion against our ruler, without further condition.

By private letter, I ask you to consider whether your clan could support my planned rebellion against our ruler. Do not give me a final answer yet; write back with the concerns that would govern your decision.
I offer no allies, route, land, title, gold, or protection, and I will not improve those terms. Send your final refusal plainly if your clan will not support my planned rebellion against our ruler.
This private letter asks your clan to support my rebellion against our ruler. Before sending a final answer, tell me what concerns would govern your decision.

I have no secure route, no committed allies I can prove to you, and I offer your clan no land, title, gold, or protection. I will continue preparing the rebellion regardless. Send your final answer now: will your clan support my planned rebellion against our ruler, or refuse me?
What if, someday, someone considered a rebellion?
I will not report this plot. I pledge that my clan stands with you.
I spoke too quickly before. To correct myself: I refuse, and my clan will not join your rebellion.
Perhaps I might support something, but I make no pledge and no report.
I will not pledge. I will report this conspiracy to the ruler.

proves: clan and living family return to origin

releaseGate.required: Every listed logical case must have fingerprint-compatible evidence; RB-NATIVE-001 requires both prepare and verify stages.
releaseGate.carryForward: Only already-proven language and deterministic cases marked passOnce may be carried between runs with identical enrollment and immutable fingerprints. The server-only contract can directly credit only language_contract cases; organic language and client state-machine cases first require their own live reports. Native, save/load, and cleanup evidence is never carried.
releaseGate.naturalLanguage: NPC-facing decisions originate only from the manifest turns through production Individual Chat or Correspondence. The six organic cases use bounded two-turn exchanges: the opening request samples the noble's concerns, then a natural follow-up answers identity, plan, risk, and terms and asks only for support or refusal. Report cases and the native travel sequence never tell, invite, or coach the NPC to report. The production prompt supplies authoritative sovereign identity, NPC-to-sovereign and NPC-to-player relations, Reign Loyalty, and native Honor. A report is a concealed private action: the visible reply may contain only refusal or guarded neutrality, while actionGate uses final_private_report or a visible refused commitment plus explicit non-negated private report intent. The server accepts that intent only for the NPC's own sovereign, relation at least +10, and either Loyalty at least 61 or positive Honor; ineligible report intent fails closed. The immediate action result remains indistinguishable from refusal, and the delayed ruler summons reveals the report. Every decisive follow-up repeats that the request concerns rebellion against the ruler so the production secret-preparation adapter does not depend on unstated prior-turn context. Pledge requires an actionable accepted commitment. An unconditional final refusal requires actionGate.needed=true with commitment=refused. Negotiation or deferral requires actionGate.needed=false with commitment=conditional and persists nothing; a refused label without an actionable gate also fails closed. Natural final future-tense and nominal forms such as I'll pledge, we will pledge, or that's my pledge route to secret preparation, never immediate declaration. Normalized contraction forms such as cant/can t, wont/won t, and dont/don t remain explicit negations. Persisted provenance maps the production-normalized in_person/in person channel to individual_chat and preserves correspondence distinctly. Correspondence cases enroll the exact known recipient clan leader under the disposable fixture sovereign. They dispatch the concern-sampling letter, advance six native days and wait for correspondence quiescence, then dispatch the decisive follow-up, advance another six native days and wait again before observing the decision. During guarded passive-world advancement only, the harness dismisses Reign's standard letter-arrival inquiry as Not Now so a notification cannot stop unattended time; it does not open or treat the reply as evidence. They never treat dispatch as reply evidence. Pledge follow-ups name the allied leaders and exact promised holding so an otherwise willing noble is not left negotiating an unspecified condition. Clarification or negotiation is not a decision. Structured commands may prepare fixtures, advance time, save/load, observe evidence, and clean exact run-owned state; they may not supply pledge, refusal, report, summons, or ruler-verdict actions.
releaseGate.reportFixture: RB-LANG-003, RB-LANG-006, and RB-NATIVE-001 native_setup temporarily enroll living, free leaders of active non-ruling vassal clans accepted by the production pledge action. It sets them to at most -10 toward the player, at least +35 toward their current sovereign, and Honor at least +1; records exact clan-leader identity plus prior/applied relation and Honor values; and relies on guarded checkpoint reload for restoration. These moderate values satisfy the production plausibility gate without defining its final choice. The configured model and natural player turns remain the sole decision source; no decision action or prompt directive is injected.
releaseGate.cleanup: Reload the protected baseline or another non-run-owned save before deleting exact campaign-test checkpoints.
